title: Recycle handoff at the WCLI-11 / DEC-19 boundary
description: A recycle handoff written and discharged in one session, at opum-agent renewal order on 2026-09-29, at the WCLI-11 / DEC-19 boundary. It is the test case for opum-agent OPAG-678 AC3: a session whose handoff task is discharged in-session should reach CLEAR with no manual cursor re-write. Read THIS record first; it points at the work.
implementationNotes:
RECYCLE HANDOFF, written at opum-agent renewal order on 2026-09-29 and DISCHARGED IN-SESSION on purpose. This task is the test case for OPAG-678 AC3: a recycle whose handoff task is created, worked and completed in one session, so the successor reaches CLEAR with no manual cursor re-write. The cursor is left to the session-end flush hook — do not hand-write it. A successor should treat THIS record as the handoff, and WCLI-11 record as the work it points at.

WHERE THE REPOSITORY IS. dev and main both carry the WCLI-11 audit work: `ward audit` (this project sanitized events, oldest first, with the vault-wide retention bound of 500 and this project retained count stated in the output), the T19 evidence measured through the real store under a held vault lock, and the two review fixes. PR opum-ai/ward-cli#72 merged as 88c9084; the pause chore merged as dbe4403; dbe4403 was promoted to main by fast-forward (`git push origin origin/dev:main`) and verified by reading origin/main by ref. WCLI-11 is PAUSED on DEC-19 — both acceptance criteria checked; the only remaining scope is the spec 9.4 fuller field set. WCLI-39 is filed and unstarted.

FIRST ACTION. Read the WCLI-11 record in this order: the SPLIT note (scope, and what WCLI-10 already owned), the RECYCLE HANDOFF and RECYCLE NOTE (survey, plan, environment), then the REVIEW AND MERGE NOTE (what landed, the reviewer two findings and their fixes). Then take DEC-19 answer if it has arrived.

THE ONE OPEN DECISION: DEC-19 (opum-agent tracker, routed via opum-doc). It asks what happens to a vault that already holds audit records when the field set — observed OS identity plus optional explicitly self-asserted actor/task labels — is added, because the state parser checks each record against an exact key set. Arm A, recommended and carried whole to the operator: additive and tolerant — the parser knows the old 8-key shape and the new one, both still exact-key-set checked; old records display the new fields as not recorded; vaultStateFormatVersion stays 1; the bump-or-explain reasoning goes above the constant the way WCLI-10 recorded profileSnapshotVersion, and the release-gate obligation is filed the way WCLI-38 was. Arm B: strict, bump vaultStateFormatVersion to 2 — every pre-change vault, secrets included, becomes unreadable with no migration or read-out path, and the first bump arrives before the first release. Whichever arm lands, it comes as its own follow-up PR: the #72 branch was removed at the squash, so nothing can ride it.

WHAT THE FIELD-SET CHANGE TOUCHES, surveyed rather than written: AuditRecord and ownAuditRecord (the exact-key-set parser) in src/domain/vault-state.ts; serializeVaultState; the writeAudit path in src/application/run.ts, where the observed identity should be an injected port the way `now` and `newId` are; the display in src/application/audit.ts; and, if the self-asserted labels are to be settable, a supply surface on `ward run` bounded by the existing alias grammar (64 chars, a letter then letters/digits/._-) so no free text can enter a displayed record. Labels are self-asserted and never authorization (spec 4.2, 12).

THEN, IN ORDER: WCLI-39 (one manifest/binding resolution rule instead of the four private copies); then the ready set, `quest task list --ready`. Notable ready work: WCLI-38 (the release-time profileSnapshotVersion decision), WCLI-37 (approved request bodies from stdin, json-stdin), WCLI-14 (agent bridges, skill and opum-ward plugin packaging), WCLI-12 (exact use-only cross-project grants and revocation), WCLI-33, WCLI-29, WCLI-30, WCLI-34, WCLI-35, WCLI-36. WCLI-19 is an accepted P0 limitation and WCLI-21 / WCLI-22 are platform-gated; read them before treating them as actionable.

STATE, VERIFIED RATHER THAN REMEMBERED at this write: no open pull requests, working tree clean, local branches dev and main only, WCLI-11 Paused with no other task In Progress or Paused, disk measured at 485 GiB on /Volumes/external and 11 GiB on the system volume. Disk was at 100 percent twice earlier on 2026-09-29, and a predecessor recorded DEC-17 (opum-agent tracker, not readable from this repository) as open with the operator — re-measure before claiming a full local gate ran.

OPERATIONAL NOTES, MEASURED THIS SESSION. `gh pr checks` can report zero checks for a few seconds after a push, so a wait loop must require the expected row count and not only the absence of pending. A merged branch is deleted remotely by delete_branch_on_merge but never locally — delete with -D after confirming the PR is MERGED. Merge with `gh pr merge <n> --squash` run bare: a composed command falls outside the allow rule and is refused on consent grounds that name the wrong cause.

RAILS, unchanged. No test or agent probe touches the real ~/.ward vault or its keychain item; never request a real credential in an agent session; publish nothing. The test TLS material under test/fixtures/tls is a throwaway CA trusted nowhere.

SKILLS for the successor: opum-sdlc (branch, PR, merge, promote, cleanup), opum-handoff (restore), quest, lore.
